list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM otel_logs ORDER BY 1

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'mindmemos-skill' AND if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) != '' ORDER BY 1

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT if(SpanAttributes['run_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['run_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'mindmemos-skill' AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) IN (${project:singlequote})) AND if(SpanAttributes['run_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['run_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) != '' ORDER BY 1

list.name: span_name
list.label: Span name
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT SpanName FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'mindmemos-skill' ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 30 SECOND) AS time, SpanName, count() AS spans FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['run_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['run_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) IN (${run:singlequote})) AND (arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['request_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) OR TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '' UNION DISTINCT SELECT TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '')) AND (arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['attempt'] = arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}]) = '' OR TraceId = arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}])) AND ('*' IN (${span_name:singlequote}) OR SpanName IN (${span_name:singlequote})) GROUP BY time, SpanName ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 30 SECOND) AS time, SeverityText, count() AS logs FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR if(LogAttributes['project_id'] != '', LogAttributes['project_id'], LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR if(LogAttributes['run_id'] != '', LogAttributes['run_id'], LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) IN (${run:singlequote})) AND (arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}]) = '' OR LogAttributes['request_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) = '' OR LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) OR TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '' UNION DISTINCT SELECT TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '')) AND (arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}]) = '' OR LogAttributes['attempt'] = arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}]) = '' OR TraceId = arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}])) GROUP BY time, SeverityText ORDER BY time

SELECT count() AS error_spans FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['run_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['run_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) IN (${run:singlequote})) AND (arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['request_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) OR TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '' UNION DISTINCT SELECT TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '')) AND (arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['attempt'] = arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}]) = '' OR TraceId = arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}])) AND StatusCode = 'Error' AND ('*' IN (${span_name:singlequote}) OR SpanName IN (${span_name:singlequote}))

SELECT count() AS spans FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['run_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['run_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) IN (${run:singlequote})) AND (arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['request_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) OR TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '' UNION DISTINCT SELECT TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '')) AND (arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['attempt'] = arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}]) = '' OR TraceId = arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}])) AND ('*' IN (${span_name:singlequote}) OR SpanName IN (${span_name:singlequote}))

panels.title: Algorithm execution duration
panels.description: Completed algorithm root spans, including failures. Queue wait is excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 30 SECOND) AS time, SpanName, avg(Duration) / 1e9 AS average_s, quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e9 AS p95_s FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['run_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['run_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) IN (${run:singlequote})) AND (arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['request_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) OR TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '' UNION DISTINCT SELECT TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '')) AND (arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['attempt'] = arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}]) = '' OR TraceId = arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}])) AND SpanName IN ('algorithm.train', 'algorithm.evolve') AND ('*' IN (${span_name:singlequote}) OR SpanName IN (${span_name:singlequote})) GROUP BY time, SpanName ORDER BY time

SELECT Timestamp, if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) AS project_id, if(SpanAttributes['run_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['run_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) AS run_id, SpanName, round(Duration / 1e9, 3) AS duration_s, StatusCode, SpanAttributes['error.type'] AS error_type, TraceId, SpanId, ParentSpanId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['run_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['run_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) IN (${run:singlequote})) AND (arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['request_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) OR TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '' UNION DISTINCT SELECT TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '')) AND (arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['attempt'] = arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}]) = '' OR TraceId = arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}])) AND ('*' IN (${span_name:singlequote}) OR SpanName IN (${span_name:singlequote})) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT Timestamp, SeverityText, if(LogAttributes['project_id'] != '', LogAttributes['project_id'], LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) AS project_id, if(LogAttributes['run_id'] != '', LogAttributes['run_id'], LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) AS run_id, Body, TraceId, SpanId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR if(LogAttributes['project_id'] != '', LogAttributes['project_id'], LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR if(LogAttributes['run_id'] != '', LogAttributes['run_id'], LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) IN (${run:singlequote})) AND (arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}]) = '' OR LogAttributes['request_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) = '' OR LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) OR TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '' UNION DISTINCT SELECT TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '')) AND (arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}]) = '' OR LogAttributes['attempt'] = arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}]) = '' OR TraceId = arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}])) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Algorithm errors and traceback

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp, if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) AS project_id, if(SpanAttributes['run_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['run_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) AS run_id, SpanName, round(Duration / 1e9, 3) AS duration_s, SpanAttributes['error.type'] AS error_type, SpanAttributes['error.occurred_at'] AS occurred_at, SpanAttributes['error.stage'] AS stage, coalesce(nullIf(SpanAttributes['error.traceback'], ''), nullIf(SpanAttributes['exception.stacktrace'], ''), arrayFirst(x -> x['exception.stacktrace'] != '', `Events.Attributes`)['exception.stacktrace']) AS traceback, StatusMessage, TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['run_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['run_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) IN (${run:singlequote})) AND (arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['request_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) OR TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '' UNION DISTINCT SELECT TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '')) AND (arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['attempt'] = arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}]) = '' OR TraceId = arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}])) AND StatusCode = 'Error' AND ('*' IN (${span_name:singlequote}) OR SpanName IN (${span_name:singlequote})) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: Empty traceback means the producer did not export it. Timestamp is span start; occurred_at is the exported error time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp, SpanName, TraceId, SpanAttributes['request_id'] AS request_id, Duration / 1000000 AS duration_ms, SpanAttributes['arguments'] AS input, SpanAttributes['result'] AS output, StatusCode, SpanAttributes FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['run_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['run_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) IN (${run:singlequote})) AND (arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['request_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) OR TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '' UNION DISTINCT SELECT TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '')) AND (arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['attempt'] = arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}]) = '' OR TraceId = arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}])) AND (SpanName LIKE 'service.%' OR SpanName = 'http.request') ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Task end-to-end and current attempt duration

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp, SpanAttributes['task_id'] AS task_id, SpanAttributes['attempt'] AS attempt, toFloat64OrNull(SpanAttributes['waiting_ms']) AS waiting_ms, toFloat64OrNull(SpanAttributes['execution_ms']) AS execution_ms, toFloat64OrNull(SpanAttributes['end_to_end_ms']) AS end_to_end_ms, SpanAttributes['status'] AS status, TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['run_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['run_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) IN (${run:singlequote})) AND (arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['request_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) OR TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '' UNION DISTINCT SELECT TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '')) AND (arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['attempt'] = arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}]) = '' OR TraceId = arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}])) AND SpanName = 'task.execute' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT Timestamp, SpanAttributes['stage'] AS stage, Duration / 1000000 AS duration_ms, StatusCode, SpanAttributes['task_id'] AS task_id, TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['run_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['run_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) IN (${run:singlequote})) AND (arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['request_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) OR TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '' UNION DISTINCT SELECT TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '')) AND (arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['attempt'] = arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}]) = '' OR TraceId = arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}])) AND SpanAttributes['stage'] != '' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Raw spans, exception events and parent relationships

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp, TraceId, SpanId, ParentSpanId, SpanName, SpanAttributes, `Events.Name`, `Events.Attributes`, ResourceAttributes FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['project_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['project_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR if(SpanAttributes['run_id'] != '', SpanAttributes['run_id'], SpanAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) IN (${run:singlequote})) AND (arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['request_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) OR TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '' UNION DISTINCT SELECT TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '')) AND (arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}]) = '' OR SpanAttributes['attempt'] = arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}]) = '' OR TraceId = arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}])) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Request/task logs with input, output and traceback

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp, TraceId, SpanId, SeverityText, LogAttributes['request_id'] AS request_id, LogAttributes['task_id'] AS task_id, Body, LogAttributes['exception.stacktrace'] AS traceback, LogAttributes FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR if(LogAttributes['project_id'] != '', LogAttributes['project_id'], LogAttributes['algorithm.project_id']) IN (${project:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${run:singlequote}) OR if(LogAttributes['run_id'] != '', LogAttributes['run_id'], LogAttributes['algorithm.run_id']) IN (${run:singlequote})) AND (arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}]) = '' OR LogAttributes['request_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${request:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) = '' OR LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) OR TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '' UNION DISTINCT SELECT TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['task_id'] = arrayStringConcat([${task:sqlstring}]) AND TraceId != '')) AND (arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}]) = '' OR LogAttributes['attempt'] = arrayStringConcat([${attempt:sqlstring}])) AND (arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}]) = '' OR TraceId = arrayStringConcat([${trace:sqlstring}])) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: Database task counts by project (latest 30-second sample)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ServiceName, LogAttributes['project_id'] AS project, argMax(JSONExtractInt(Body, 'queued'), Timestamp) AS queued, argMax(JSONExtractInt(Body, 'running'), Timestamp) AS running, argMax(JSONExtractInt(Body, 'succeeded'), Timestamp) AS succeeded, argMax(JSONExtractInt(Body, 'failed'), Timestamp) AS failed, max(Timestamp) AS sampled_at FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['project_id'] IN (${project:singlequote})) AND JSONHas(Body, 'queued') AND JSONHas(Body, 'group_id') GROUP BY ServiceName, project

panels.title: Kafka notification lag (broker offsets, independent of DB backlog)

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['topic'] AS topic, Attributes['consumergroup'] AS consumer_group, Attributes['partition'] AS partition, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS lag, max(TimeUnix) AS sampled_at FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'kafka_consumergroup_lag' AND Attributes['topic'] IN (SELECT JSONExtractString(Body, 'topic') FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) AND ('*' IN (${project:singlequote}) OR LogAttributes['project_id'] IN (${project:singlequote})) AND JSONHas(Body, 'group_id')) GROUP BY topic, consumer_group, partition ORDER BY topic, consumer_group, partition

SELECT MetricName, Attributes, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value, max(TimeUnix) AS sampled_at FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND (MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_receiver_%' OR MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_exporter_%') GROUP BY MetricName, Attributes ORDER BY MetricName

panels.title: Last received data (empty or stale data is not zero activity)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ServiceName, count() AS received_logs, max(Timestamp) AS last_received_at, dateDiff('second', max(Timestamp), now()) AS seconds_since_last_log FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('*' IN (${service:singlequote}) OR ServiceName IN (${service:singlequote})) GROUP BY ServiceName
